A decision model: typed questions (noul / choice / score) over a text, an image or an audio clip -> calibrated probabilities; it never generates text. Twelve graphs, each tensor in / tensor out, with the tokenizer, the mel front end, the image tiling / resize / unshuffle and the read-out on the host: decide_<L> for L128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096, the vision tower, the projector and audio_<T> for T501 / 1001 / 2001 / 3001. The shipped decision, tower and audio files carry the lane's fp16-safe norm rewrite (the pre-rewrite decision files collapse in fp16 arithmetic on this phone: every row uniform on OpenCL FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM in round 5, 19 of 20 rows non-finite on the HTP in round 10 leg N3); legs on pre-rewrite or other bytes are not records.
